content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'd like to ask about the limit on expansion modules for my [product_name]. Right now, my setup includes: 1 x [product_name] main unit 2 x [product_name] digital modules Is it possible to add additional expansion modules? Appreciate any help.

The current [product_name] platform with [version_no] supports: - Up to 24 digital inputs - Up to 20 digital outputs - Up to 8 analog inputs - Up to 8 analog outputs Your main device provides 8 digital inputs and 4 digital outputs, with no analog inputs or outputs. Digital inputs total: Main module: 8 2 digital modules: 16 Total: 24, so no further digital expansion is possible. Digital outputs total: Main module: 4 2 digital modules: 16 Total: 20, so no further digital expansion is possible. Analog inputs: Main module: 0 Available: 0, but you can add up to 4 analog modules (each with 2 analog inputs). Analog outputs: Main module: 0 Available: 0, but you can add up to 4 analog modules (each with 2 analog outputs).
That makes everything much clearer. Thanks for the explanation!

The conversation highlights the hardware limits for digital IO, clearly explaining when those thresholds are reached, while also outlining remaining possibilities for analog IO expansion. Documentation regarding these expansion limits seems to be well understood by experienced users.
